name: JumpGuard
tagline: 在 iOS 17.0–17.3.1 上确认、允许或阻止 App 发起的跨应用跳转。
description: JumpGuard 在第三方 App 尝试打开其他 App 时提供确认与规则管理，减少未经确认的自动跳转。
所有规则和跳转记录均保存在设备本地；JumpGuard 不会移除或屏蔽广告内容。
features: 跨 App 跳转前弹窗确认
支持仅允许一次、始终允许、始终不允许和取消
可将指定来源 App 加入黑名单并静默阻止其外跳
管理 URL 放行规则及来源到目标的允许或阻止规则
记录跳转来源、目标、次数与时间
默认隐藏 URL 中的敏感参数
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 JumpGuard。
开启总开关，并按需配置来源 App 黑名单或跳转规则。
遇到跨 App 跳转时选择一次性或长期处理方式。
可在设置中查看、删除跳转记录与已保存规则。

changes: 新增跨 App 跳转确认、来源黑名单和允许或阻止规则。
新增本地跳转记录与 URL 隐私显示控制。
增强关键系统流程的兼容性与使用稳定性。

en.name: JumpGuard
en.tagline: Confirm, allow, or block cross-app launch requests on iOS 17.0–17.3.1.
description: JumpGuard provides confirmation and rule management when third-party apps try to open another app, reducing unwanted automatic launches.
All rules and launch history remain on your device; JumpGuard does not remove or block advertisements.
features: Confirm before one app opens another
Allow once, always allow, always deny, or cancel
Silently block all external launches from selected source apps
Manage URL allow rules and source-to-destination allow or deny rules
Record launch source, destination, count, and time
Hide sensitive URL parameters by default
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open JumpGuard in Settings after installation.
Enable the main switch and configure source-app blocking or launch rules as needed.
Choose a one-time or persistent action when a cross-app launch is requested.
Review or delete launch history and saved rules from Settings.

changes: Added cross-app launch confirmation, source-app blocking, and allow or deny rules.
Added on-device launch history and URL privacy controls.
Improved compatibility and stability for critical system flows.
